ey.title: Eye-toggles
ey.sub: Every part of a shop page you can show or hide on its own, in one searchable list.
ey.note: Hiding a part never deletes it: switch it on again and it comes back as it was. Each switch is the same one as in its section's own settings, so both always agree.
ey.none: No switch matches. Try another word or clear the search.
ey.saved: Saved. The shop shows it now.
ey.readOnly: You can see these switches. Changing them needs the permission "Show or hide any one part of a shop page".

err.INVALID_INPUT: Not saved: a switch is not known: {details}
err.STALE: Not saved: someone changed these settings in between. The list is fresh now; change it again and save.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission to change these switches.
err.unauthorized: You were signed out. Sign in again.

door.title: Door note words
door.text: The door note shows only your own words, under the delivery area once it is settled. Write only what your Cash on Delivery and return rules really do. Empty: nothing shows, even with the switch on.
door.empty: No words yet: nothing shows on checkout.
